summary: This run reverified the core direct competitors, refreshed adjacent monetization references, and added four newly tracked products that matter because they package trust, savings, or a narrow wedge better than FX Inline currently does.

notable_market_changes.change: Still shows a real freemium motion with a visible 7.95 USD/month extension plan and a stronger trust surface than FX Inline.
Still proves that monetization alone is not enough; the product remains weakly rated despite a clear premium offer.
Still shows the category tradeoff clearly: useful flexibility plus recurring complaints about complexity, accuracy, and performance.
Merchant-side localization products keep proving willingness to pay when the product clearly improves conversion and revenue.

newly_tracked_competitors.name: PriceTip
newly_tracked_competitors.traction: Chrome Web Store shows 7,000 users and 141 ratings at 4.7.
newly_tracked_competitors.positioning: Hover-first currency tooltip conversion with automatic rate updates and strong multilingual packaging.
newly_tracked_competitors.why_it_matters: Strong trust, good public rating, and a clean privacy story show how much packaging matters in a crowded free category.

newly_tracked_competitors.name: Minimal Currency Converter
newly_tracked_competitors.traction: Chrome Web Store shows 338 users and 13 ratings at 4.5.
newly_tracked_competitors.positioning: Open-source, minimal, multi-currency popup with no permissions required.
newly_tracked_competitors.why_it_matters: It sells transparency and no-permission trust directly, which is useful contrast against FX Inline's broader runtime surface.

newly_tracked_competitors.name: RETA
newly_tracked_competitors.traction: Official site was visible; no strong public install or rating signal was verified this run.
newly_tracked_competitors.positioning: Private-by-design multi-store comparison with unit price, delivery, coupon-adjusted totals, and optional AI summaries.
newly_tracked_competitors.why_it_matters: It frames the buyer outcome as better comparison math rather than raw currency conversion.

newly_tracked_competitors.name: AmazonSaver
newly_tracked_competitors.traction: Official site claims a 5.0 user rating and support for 10+ Amazon Europe stores; independent install volume was not verified this run.
newly_tracked_competitors.positioning: Cross-market Amazon Europe comparison with automatic currency conversion and clear savings framing.
newly_tracked_competitors.why_it_matters: It is a good example of a narrow wedge with obvious ROI and easier marketing than a generic converter.

reverified_competitors.name: Savely
reverified_competitors.change: Reverified. Still shows 5,000 users and 24 ratings at 4.3, with affiliate monetization disclosed clearly in the store listing.

reverified_competitors.name: BestPrice Assistant
reverified_competitors.change: Reverified. Still matters because it sells savings, offers, and automatic euro conversion rather than generic FX utility.

reverified_competitors.name: XE Currency Data API
reverified_competitors.change: Reverified. Paid B2B pricing remains visible, which still matters as proof that business buyers will pay in the FX space when the value is operational.

reverified_competitors.name: Wise Partnerships
reverified_competitors.change: Reverified. Wise still runs explicit website, influencer, and business partnership programs.

reverified_competitors.name: Travelpayouts
reverified_competitors.change: Reverified. The platform still positions itself as a broad travel affiliate engine for creators and publishers.
